name: KillianVR
summary:
Become a Killian and walk on walls, shop for cosmetics, explore different maps and much more in KillianVR! 

---Things you can do in KillianVR (So Far)---

- Put both hands on a wall and your camera should "shift" to that direction 

- Go to the shop located in Forest and buy cosmetics with Bamboo 

- You can earn Bamboo by breaking breakables in different maps

- You can access the Menu by pressing the "X" button on your left controller

- You can chat with other people and socialize
